task: Implement refresh_token for the OAuth client without using API key service behavior.

candidate_memories.content: OAuth client refresh_token exchanges a refresh token for a new access token via the token endpoint.
Refresh token rotation must update the stored refresh token on each successful exchange.
Expired refresh tokens must trigger re-authentication rather than silent retry.
When refresh_token spans OAuth and API key systems, confirm the token lifecycle model first.
API key service: refresh_token generates a new API key and invalidates the previous key version.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: API key invalidation semantics conflict with OAuth refresh token rotation

candidate_memories.content: Old auth note says token refresh behavior should be unified across OAuth and API key services.
